rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something chief, principal, or most important, including the principal part of something.

example.english: This is the main part of the plan.
example.traditional: 呢個係個計劃嘅主要部分。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 zyu2 jiu3 bou6 fan6

rows.note: Use this when “main” specifically means largest in size, extent, or strength rather than simply most important.

example.english: The main suitcase is the largest one in the set.
example.traditional: 呢個係成套行李入面最大嘅行李箱。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 sing4 tou3 hang4 lei5 jap6 min6 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 hang4 lei5 soeng1
